Datensatzklasse Record2<A1,A2>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Record2<A1,A2>
Typparameter:
A1 - the type of the first value
A2 - the type of the second value
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Supplier<A1>, Appliable2<Record2.µ, A1, A2>, Copyable<Record2<A1,A2>>, Mappable2<Record2.µ, A1, A2>, Transmogrifyable<Record2<A1,A2>>, Value<A1>, Value2<A1,A2>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<Record2.µ, A1, A2>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Record2.µ>
public record Record2<A1,A2>(A1 value1, A2 value2) extends Record implements Appliable2<Record2.µ, A1, A2>, Mappable2<Record2.µ, A1, A2>, Transmogrifyable<Record2<A1,A2>>, Copyable<Record2<A1,A2>>, Value2<A1,A2>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<Record2.µ, A1, A2>

A record-based, immutable 2-tuple carrying two non-null values. This type offers value accessors, structural updates (with1/with2), mapping utilities (map/map1/map2/mapAll), applicative application (applyTo) and conversions (toTuple), as well as transmogrification and copying.

Semantics:

  • Non-null contract: inputs must not be null, results must not be null.
  • Eager evaluation: mapping and applicative application evaluate immediately.
  • Structural equality: equals/hashCode compare values component-wise.
  • Stable string format: Record2[value1=..., value2=...]

Seit:
1.0.0
